title: Every Time We Touch, I Hear That Sound
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: Touji, an ordinary high-school student, struggles with people and dislikes being touched. On a rainy day he meets classmate Itsuki Yato, who touches him casually and keeps seeking him out, and Touji slowly wants to know him better (Futekiya blurb via AniList and MangaUpdates). MangaUpdates lists social anxiety, a camping trip and first-time intercourse between the teen leads.
life_message: Patient closeness can help an anxious person open up.
